title: Dark theme for the settings page
summary: Adds a persisted dark theme and fixes an empty-input crash in the theme resolver.

sections.requested: Add a dark theme to the settings page that persists per user, and make the theme resolver return a default instead of raising on empty input.
sections.implemented: A dark theme toggle persisted in user preferences, applied on load; the resolver now returns the default theme for empty input.
sections.verified: `pytest` 412 passed; contrast measured at 7.1:1; `html-validate` clean. Not checked: Safari.
sections.assessment: Every acceptance criterion holds and no blocking finding is open; verdict pass.

items.caption: Before — light only, no dark theme

blocks.label: Empty preferences
blocks.note: The boundary the old code crashed on.

blocks.label: Diff
blocks.text:
@@ -12,4 +12,6 @@ def theme(prefs):
-    return prefs["theme"]
+    value = prefs.get("theme", DEFAULT_THEME)
+    return value if value in THEMES else DEFAULT_THEME

findings.title: Crash on empty preferences
findings.suggestion: Return the default theme when the key is absent.

findings.title: Unknown theme value silently ignored
findings.suggestion: Fall back to the default when the stored value is not a known theme.
